# Split Pages

> 🤖 *AI Drafted (Not reviewed)*

Use this when: your photographs show an open book or notebook (two pages at once). Finds the document in each photograph and cuts it at its gutter into pages, in reading order, each a page of the photograph; a closed cover or a single page is kept whole, and an unclear gutter is proposed for review, never cut. The photographs are never changed.
